# Swarm Protective Services

> Licensed security company in Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area: event security, bar and nightclub door staff, close protection, and monitoring for homes and businesses. PSISA-licensed officers, $5M insured, WSIB covered. Based in Toronto; we travel with clients anywhere in Canada.

Motto: Life is unpredictable, let us protect you.

## Services

- **Close protection** — Executives, artists, families. [Details](https://swarmprotectiveservices.ca/close-protection)
- **Event security** — Concerts, weddings, galas. [Details](https://swarmprotectiveservices.ca/event-security)
- **Venue security** — Bars, clubs, lounges. [Details](https://swarmprotectiveservices.ca/venue-security)
- **Party bus security** — Groups on the move. [Details](https://swarmprotectiveservices.ca/party-bus-security)
- **Limousine service** — Chauffeured, secured. [Details](https://swarmprotectiveservices.ca/limousine-service)
- **Monitoring** — Homes and businesses. [Details](https://swarmprotectiveservices.ca/monitoring)

## Coverage

- Toronto and 17 cities around it. And we travel with you anywhere in Canada.
- Cities: Toronto, Etobicoke, North York, Scarborough, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Oakville, Burlington, Hamilton, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa, Milton, Newmarket.

## Licences and insurance

- PSISA licensed
- $5M insured
- WSIB covered
- Officers are not armed: Ontario does not permit private security to carry firearms.

## Answers

- **Where do you work?** We work across Toronto and 17 nearby cities in the GTA. We can also travel with you anywhere in Canada.
- **Are your officers licensed?** Yes. Every officer we send is licensed to work in security in Ontario and trained to calm tense situations rather than escalate them.
- **Are your bodyguards armed?** No. Private security officers in Ontario are not allowed to carry firearms. We keep people safe through careful planning, a steady presence and calm communication.
- **What can you cover?** Close protection, events, venues, party buses, limousine trips, and patrols for homes and businesses. If you are not sure which fits, tell us what is happening and we will suggest the right option.
- **How soon can you start?** For most jobs we can start the same day. Large events and travel need a few days so we can plan them properly.
- **How do I book you?** Send us the date, the place and roughly how many people will be there. We usually reply with a clear quote the same day.
